profile_text.body:
Symbotic Inc. is a public company headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker SYM. On its own site, the company describes itself as a provider of end-to-end warehouse automation for retailers and distributors, built around robotic systems and AI-enhanced software. It says its systems are designed to increase facility capacity through dense storage, maximize throughput, and adapt to palletized goods, small quantity fulfillment, and omnichannel operations. The site states that goods from as small as 1 lb (0.5 kg) and 2 x 6.4 x 5 in (5.1 x 16.3 x 12.7 cm) to as large as 60 lb (27.2 kg) and 36 x 24 x 16.2 in (91.4 x 61 x 41.2 cm) can be managed and fulfilled in their native packaging, and that loose items and cold chain requirements also have automation options.

The company positions itself as the software and key robotic innovator for each solution it sells, contrasting its turnkey offering with integrators it says are limited by technology partnerships. It describes itself as a leader in industrial automation and in technology at large, and states that its purpose is to get the right goods to people who need them when they need them.

The company's record shows no lawsuits and no MCP servers. Its registered location places it in Massachusetts, where 191 cases are recorded in that jurisdiction.
